summary: @servicetitan/marketing-route 1.2.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts and chmod +x's it into a temporary directory, then execFileSync's it against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line bundle with hex-mangled identifiers, a large numeric/string constant array, and a shift-based string-array rotation routine (obfuscator.io shape), with no readable strings, URLs, or logic. The declared package purpose is React marketing-route navigation; the src/ tree contains only React routing code and CHANGELOG.md documents only marketing-route features through v1.2.0 with no mention of setup.mjs, math_init.js, or a Bun-based install step. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based scanners and runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine at npm install time. The shape is consistent with a hijacked-publish of the @servicetitan scope rather than an intentional maintainer change.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
